QUOTE: "ServerManager::execute ... if PermissionManager::is_denied(...) → error JSON "Permission denied", tool never runs / else route_tool_call(...)" and "Auto-approve or the allow list is the only thing that skips prompting, and the deny list is checked last, at execution time"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows ServerManager::execute checking only is_denied before routing. It also says the allow list only skips prompting and the callback cannot refuse, so the deny list is the only list that blocks.
